points.en: NIMZs are giant industrial townships designed to be self-contained ecosystems.
points.hi: NIMZs are giant industrial townships designed to be self-contained ecosystems.

points.en: Part of the National Manufacturing Policy (NMP) 2011.
points.hi: Part of the National Manufacturing Policy (NMP) 2011.

points.en: Objective: Increase manufacturing share in GDP to 25% by 2022.
points.hi: Objective: Increase manufacturing share in GDP to 25% by 2022.

points.en: Focus: Employment generation and global competitiveness.
points.hi: Focus: Employment generation and global competitiveness.

points.en: Special Purpose Vehicle (SPV) manages the zone.
points.hi: Special Purpose Vehicle (SPV) manages the zone.

points.en: State government provides land and infrastructure.
points.hi: State government provides land and infrastructure.

points.en: Central government provides external connectivity and funding.
points.hi: Central government provides external connectivity and funding.

explanation.en: NIMZs require a minimum of 5,000 hectares of land to be designated as a zone.
explanation.hi: NIMZs require a minimum of 5,000 hectares of land to be designated as a zone.

question.en: What is the primary goal of NIMZs?
question.hi: What is the primary goal of NIMZs?

answer.en: To create world-class industrial infrastructure and boost the manufacturing sector's contribution to GDP.
answer.hi: To create world-class industrial infrastructure and boost the manufacturing sector's contribution to GDP.

misconception.en: NIMZs are the same as SEZs.
misconception.hi: NIMZs are the same as SEZs.

correction.en: NIMZs focus on manufacturing and domestic/export markets, whereas SEZs are primarily export-oriented.
correction.hi: NIMZs focus on manufacturing and domestic/export markets, whereas SEZs are primarily export-oriented.

fiveFacts.en: NIMZs are part of the National Manufacturing Policy.
fiveFacts.hi: NIMZs are part of the National Manufacturing Policy.

fiveFacts.en: They function as integrated industrial townships.
fiveFacts.hi: They function as integrated industrial townships.

fiveFacts.en: They require a minimum of 5,000 hectares.
fiveFacts.hi: They require a minimum of 5,000 hectares.

fiveFacts.en: They aim to create millions of jobs.
fiveFacts.hi: They aim to create millions of jobs.

fiveFacts.en: They are managed by a Special Purpose Vehicle (SPV).
fiveFacts.hi: They are managed by a Special Purpose Vehicle (SPV).

threeTraps.en: Assuming they are only for export-oriented units.
threeTraps.hi: Assuming they are only for export-oriented units.

threeTraps.en: Thinking they are managed directly by the Central Government.
threeTraps.hi: Thinking they are managed directly by the Central Government.
